instructions.content: NEVER use `latest` for task version pins; pin the task to a major version such as UseNode@0
NEVER store secrets in pipeline YAML variables; use Key Vault or variable groups with the secret flag
NEVER omit `displayName:` on tasks and steps
NEVER use `trigger: none` on templates used as main pipelines; configure explicit branch includes
NEVER define all logic inline in a single flat YAML; extract stages and jobs into templates
NEVER use `ubuntu-latest` or other floating vmImage values; pin e.g. ubuntu-22.04
NEVER deploy or pull the `latest` image tag in production; push `$(tag)` and `latest` but deploy only `$(tag)`
NEVER use a regular job for an environment deployment; use a deployment job with an environment
NEVER skip test result publishing or run it only on success; use condition succeededOrFailed()
NEVER deliver a complete pipeline without validating it with the azure-pipelines-validator skill, fixing issues and re-validating
Pin tasks to a major version (Docker@2); @0 is correct for GoTool, NodeTool and KubernetesManifest
Use Cache@2 for all package managers
Name stages and jobs in PascalCase
Write displayName in sentence case
Name variables in camelCase or snake_case and stay consistent
Use service connections for registry and cluster authentication
Use variable groups for environment-specific configuration
Use dependsOn to order stages and allow parallelism
Set timeoutInMinutes and use continueOnError for non-critical steps
Publish code coverage results with PublishCodeCoverageResults@1 as well as test results
Tag Docker images with `$(Build.BuildId)` as the primary tag
For Go use GoTool@0 and cache modules at $(GOPATH)/pkg/mod keyed on go.sum
For Go run `go vet ./...` before tests and use -race and -coverprofile on test runs
For Go build container binaries with CGO_ENABLED=0
For templates use the `${{ parameters.name }}` syntax and generate both the template and the consuming pipeline
For Kubernetes use KubernetesManifest@0 or Kubernetes@1 with namespace management and health checks
Prefer local reference docs and use Context7 or web search only for tasks not covered locally
